subject: Request: promo stacking exception for SeedSprint university cohort
messages:
From: Emily Rios <emily@seedsprint.org>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: finance@campusfoundry.edu
Date: Tue, 1 Apr 2025 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Promo stacking exception for SeedSprint university cohort

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team loved Redwood's latency and the cost tooling. We're running a university-focused cohort in May (SeedSprint: 50 teams from Campus Foundry) and wanted to ask if Redwood can make a one-off promo-stacking exception.

Current ask: allow our Campus Foundry vouchers (distributed to student teams) to stack with a one-time promotional credit from Redwood so each team can get a larger runway during the 8-week program. Specifically:
- 50 teams
- Campus Foundry vouchers cover the first $500 per team
- Requesting a stacked Redwood promo credit of $2,000 per team (consumable within 90 days)

Use case: heavy embedding usage during demo week + model eval runs. If we can offer stacked credits, it significantly increases the chance of teams converting to paid/dedicated post-cohort. We can provide a PO or campus finance contact if that helps.

Attached is the cohort roster and a short program brief. Can Redwood do a promo-stack carveout for a non-profit university cohort? If there's a counterproposal (smaller per-team credit, cohort cap, or conversion commitment), we're open.

Appreciate any quick guidance — SeedSprint needs to finalize partner credits by 4/7.

Best,
Emily Rios
Program Director, SeedSprint
seed_sprint_roster.xlsx (attachment)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: emily@seedsprint.org
Date: Tue, 1 Apr 2025 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Promo stacking exception for SeedSprint university cohort

Laura / Ben — looping you both for quick decisioning. Emily from SeedSprint is requesting to stack their Campus Foundry vouchers with a Redwood promo credit for 50 student teams (2k/team preferred). Key constraints:
- Total promo exposure ~ $100k if we do full 2k x 50
- Program is nonprofit / university (higher likelihood of conversion but lower immediate ARR)
- Deadline for partner confirmation: 4/7

My suggested options:
1) Approve a capped stacking exception: Redwood promo credit of $1,500 per team capped at 50 teams (total $75k). Require a conversion commitment (50% of teams convert to paid within 6 months) or a follow-up debrief for marketing/ref case.
2) Approve a smaller credit (1k/team) with a guaranteed Campus Foundry PO to cover 30% of any overage and a required cohort case study.
3) Decline stacking; offer an alternative — a dedicated cohort discount (10% off conversion to Dedicated for teams that sign within 90 days) + smaller promo credit.

If we approve, we'll need finance/legal to sign the addendum and confirm invoicing/po path. Emily mentioned they can provide a PO from Campus Foundry.

Questions for you: which option would you greenlight quickly? Also want to confirm whether this qualifies for the "nonprofit education" cut (special pricing) or needs an executive sign-off.

Thanks,
Jonas
Head of Growth Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 2 Apr 2025 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Promo stacking exception for SeedSprint university cohort

Thanks for the context, Jonas. I prefer option 1 with tighter guardrails. Approve a capped stacking exception with these guardrails:
- Promo credit: $1,500 per team, capped at 50 teams (total Redwood exposure: $75,000)
- Promo valid for 90 days from issuance, non-transferable
- Requirement: Campus Foundry to sign an addendum confirming vouchers and to provide a PO for administrative fees (we won't invoice them for the promo, but PO needed for our records)
- Marketing/case ask: SeedSprint to participate in a short post-cohort case study and allow Redwood to publish anonymized results (standard release)
- Finance to confirm we can recognize this as a promotional expense and not a revenue credit impacting rev-rec.

Ben — can you draft a short addendum (1 page) that captures the above? I'll waive the executive escalation on the condition finance signs off.

Attaching a template addendum to speed the process. Once Ben posts the DocuSign link, Jonas can send final confirmation to Emily.

Laura
Head, Startup Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachment: promo_stack_addendum_v1.docx

Emily — good news: we can make a one-off exception with the following agreed terms. Please confirm so we can send the addendum for signature by Friday.

Summary of agreed exception:
- Redwood promo credit: $1,500 per team for up to 50 teams (maximum Redwood promo value: $75,000)
- Promo valid for 90 days from DocuSign signature
- Non-transferable; applies only to listed SeedSprint/Campus Foundry teams in the attached roster
- Requirement: Campus Foundry to provide a PO (administrative) and sign the addendum; Redwood will not invoice Campus Foundry for the promo value but needs the PO for internal accounting
- Marketing ask: SeedSprint agrees to a short post-cohort case study and permission for Redwood to publish anonymized usage highlights

Next steps:
1) Ben (copied) will post the DocuSign link with the addendum and the roster pre-attached.
2) Campus Foundry to return PO to billing@redwood.ai within 7 days of the DocuSign signature.
3) Promo credits issued within 5 business days after DocuSign completion and PO receipt.

DocuSign link (one-time use): https://docusign.example.com/seed-sprint-addendum/ABC123

If that works, reply-all with "Confirmed" and we will kick off signatures.

Thanks — excited to support SeedSprint.

Jonas Weber
